description: This file defines the PayloadBuilder interface used for constructing Payload instances with various optional parameters such as value, extra info, status, revision, timestamp, metadata, and fields.

classes.name: PayloadBuilder
classes.description: An interface for building Payload objects with methods to set various properties.

methods.name: withValue
methods.description: Sets the value of the payload, replacing any previously set value.

methods.name: withExtra
methods.description: Sets additional information to enrich the payload.

methods.name: withStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the payload, either via HttpStatusCode or integer.

methods.name: withRevision
methods.description: Sets the revision number of the payload.

methods.name: withTimestamp
methods.description: Sets the timestamp for the payload.

methods.name: withFields
methods.description: Sets fields to include in the payload, either via JsonFieldSelector or String.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates and returns the Payload object with the set properties.
